title: Saying the Date
subtitle: What's the date today?
review: Written by Claude, modelled on the French fundamentals. Check the IPA (British) and any Burmese before using it with learners. No audio yet: record with `audio.py words`.

groups.title: The date
notes: You write 3 May (or 3rd May). You say the third of May.
American English puts the month first: May third, written May 3.

groups.title: Birthdays
notes: on + a date: on the tenth of August. in + a month: in March.

words.fr: My birthday is on the tenth of August.

groups.title: The year
notes: A year is said in two halves: 19 | 99, 20 | 25.
Use in before a year: in 2026.
